comparison.objective: Separate finishing media from washers, versus transferring a spring peg from a basket rim to secure a photo on a wire.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual screen control and agitation versus squeezing, relocating and releasing a spring clamp around wire and paper.
comparison.success_condition: Recovered media, retained washers and no spill versus peg closed on both photo and wire with the photo still supported.
comparison.reason: Spring-clamp transfer and layered capture do not test size-selective granular flow.
